title: Conductor product metrics contract, v2
description: The response of GET {baseUrl}?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD. See docs/integrations-product-metrics.md. This file is the source of truth for the shape; the prose explains the meaning. Version 2 adds optional fields to version 1; a version 1 response is still valid, but v2-only fields (basis, area, description, headline, watchBandPct, keyword:/ad: dimensions, restatementDays above 30) are only read when contractVersion is 2.

timezone.description: IANA zone name the days are reckoned in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles.

dataCompleteThrough.description: The last day whose numbers are final. Days after it are stored provisional and re-read.

restatementDays.description: How many days back the backend may still change a number after it has reported it. At most 30 on version 1; up to 60 on version 2, so cohorts can mature.

reference.description: Optional totals Conductor cross-checks against its own store and ads connectors.

key.description: Stable identifier; lowercase letters, digits and underscores; must not start with ref_.

aggregation.description: SUM adds daily values over a window; LEVEL is a stock whose latest value counts; RATIO is sum(numerator) / sum(denominator) over the window.

numerator.description: RATIO only: key of a SUM or LEVEL metric in this response.

denominator.description: RATIO only: key of a SUM or LEVEL metric in this response.

good.description: Which direction reads as good news.

funnelOrder.description: Places the metric as a stage of the in-app funnel, 1 first. Absent means not a funnel stage.

basis.description: v2. EVENT: a point counts what happened on its day. COHORT: a point's day is the day its members first opened, and its value is how many of them reached the stage by dataCompleteThrough. Restate cohort days as they mature (see restatementDays).

area.description: v2. Which part of the growth scorecard the metric belongs to.

description.description: v2. What the metric counts, in plain words, e.g. 'Installs that started a free trial'.

headline.description: v2. Priority among the headline metrics, 1 first. Absent means not a headline metric.

watchBandPct.description: v2. A miss within this percent of the target reads as Close (WATCH) instead of Off target. Default 10.

metric.description: A key from metrics; not a RATIO metric.

dimension.description: Null for the day's total. source:<name> or campaign:<id>:<name> for a breakdown row; v2 also keyword:<id>:<text> and ad:<id>:<name>.

sampleSize.description: How many users or events the value rests on. Under 20 reads as insufficient data. Never a list of ids.
